name: bibliogest
description: Sistema Integrado de Gestão e Automação de Bibliotecas (BiblioGest)

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.db:push: cd backend && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
